name: Hinomiya Tomori
source:
A second-year student, and [url=/c13882]Ayumu[/url]'s classmate. Tomori is a kind and gentle girl who also happens to be [url=/c13887]Hinomiya Rei[/url]'s younger sister. She and her brother are said to be quite close. Friends with Yumina since they entered the academy together, Tomori has been instrumental to [url=/c13883]Yumina[/url]'s advancement. Without her help, Yumina would never have made it to second year. While she does not take part in this election's debate battles, she does provide support for Yumina and the rest of the Debate Club. Tomori has never had a boyfriend. This is due in large part to the fact that attempts to get close to her are invariably met with violent interference from an unknown third party.

“ Let's all try to have a good time, okay? ”

from [url=http://www.jastusa.com/yumina/tomori.html]jast website[/url]
